basic_info.description:
3-Bed, 2-Bath Condo with Stunning Views & Indoor-Outdoor Living

Spacious 1,535 sq. ft. condo in Potrero Hill with big bay windows, two view patios, and a unique open-air patio in the center for seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Features:
 Gourmet kitchen & updated bathrooms
 Two patios with great views + open-air center patio
 Solar power & EV charger
 1-car garage + shared storage
 Shared backyard

Lease Details:
 HOA fees covered in rent
 12-month lease minimum

Great location with easy access to parks, dining, and transit. Available now.

Last months rent due on signing.
